Document: Meridian pilot pricing (internal draft)
Section: Meridian pilot pricing: internal draft, not yet sent

Due to Neha Kapoor on Mon 9 Nov 2026.

Support hours and the formal SLA are set in the contract.Prices exclude GST.Pilot pricing is valid for 30 days from the date it is sent.Riya Sharma approves the final numbers before anything is sent.

Item: One-time onboarding fee; Amount: Rs 2,50,000
Item: Platform fee, per month (pilot, 3 months from go-live); Amount: Rs 3,00,000
Item: Included volume; Amount: Up to 5 million UPI transactions per month
Item: Overage; Amount: Rs 0.06 per transaction above the included volume
